name: Musume Seizon Yuugi 1/5
source:
Daichi's wife passed away many years ago, leaving him with his two daughters, Kaede and Sayaka. He's incredibly wealthy and leaves most of their raising to the maids. Now he has learned that he's dying soon and wishes to use the time he's got left to be with his daughters. However, after he breaks his promise to his younger daughter, Sayaka, she yells at him how she wishes he was dead and his eldest daughter, Kaede tells him she's in love with a boy at school. She won't be his own little girl anymore. His rage is boiling over...

To ensure his legacy remains intact, he adopts 3 more girls to be his daughters: Ayano, Yui, and Riko.
translation:
大地的妻子多年前去世，留下他和两个女儿枫和沙耶香。他非常富有，并将大部分抚养费留给了女佣。现在，他得知自己即将去世，并希望利用剩下的时间与女儿们在一起。然而，在他违背了对小女儿沙耶香的承诺后，她对他大喊大叫，希望他死掉，而他的大女儿枫则告诉他，她爱上了学校里的一个男孩。她不再是他自己的小女儿了。他的怒火已经沸腾了……

为了确保他的遗产完好无损，他又收养了3个女孩作为他的女儿：绫乃、结衣和理子。
